continuity: Tang Sadok hands the Tang Clan's sacred Myriad-Poison Ring to Jin Taekyung for Jeok Cheongang's treatment.
The Divine Physician says treatment preparations are nearly complete and that adding the Myriad-Poison Ring will make treatment possible within fifteen days.
Tang Mimi is a gentle Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake named by Tang Sadok, and the ring absorbed the creature's venom.
plot: Jin Taekyung asks Tang Sadok to lend the Myriad-Poison Ring and offers to help pursue the culprit who murdered Tang Taesang. He argues that outside assistance could reduce the Tang Clan's casualties, while the Divine Physician confirms that the ring would make Jeok Cheongang's treatment possible within fifteen days.

Tang Sadok reveals that the Myriad-Poison Ring is not merely a legend. His gentle Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake, Tang Mimi, has lost its venom because the ring absorbed it, and the snake returns the ring to Tang Sadok, who hands the Tang Clan's sacred artifact to Taekyung. The Myriad-Poison Ring acquisition condition and chain Quest are completed.
translation_decisions: Render 대사천당문 as great Sichuan Tang Clan.
Render 당미미 as Tang Mimi and 미미쨩 as Mimi-chan.
Retain Taekyung's irreverent profanity and Tang Sadok's blunt, authoritative voice.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung has acquired the Myriad-Poison Ring, completing its chain Quest.
Tang Sadok revealed the Myriad-Poison Ring as the Sichuan Tang Clan's sacred artifact and handed it to Taekyung.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and critically ill with Formless Ultimate Poison.
The Divine Physician's treatment preparations are nearly complete, and he says the ring makes treatment possible within fifteen days.
Taekyung, Cheongpung, Dong Feng, and Mungyeong are currently at the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Tang Sadok and the Green Shadow Squad continue pursuing the one-armed killer responsible for Tang Taesang's murder and the Mount Emei massacre.
The killer is an exceptionally powerful martial artist comparable to the Ten Kings who has evaded the Tang Clan and Emei Sect.
Taekyung has promised to pursue and capture or kill the culprit if the killer flees while Jeok Cheongang is being treated.
Venerable Myoryeong remains under treatment for the Black Hand Seal.
open_questions: Will the Divine Physician's fifteen-day treatment save Jeok Cheongang?
Who is the one-armed killer, and can Tang Sadok's forces capture him?
Will Venerable Myoryeong fully recover from the Black Hand Seal?
temporary_decisions: Render 활신대법 as Life-Restoring Great Technique.
Render 무형지독 as Formless Ultimate Poison.
Render 녹영대 as Green Shadow Squad.
Render 천년독각사 as Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake.
